text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"HARD ANODIZING"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) carries a tight ISO fit on a part that is hard anodized, but the drawing does not state whether the H7 tolerance applies before or after coating. Hard anodizing adds measurable thickness inside the bore, so without this instruction the mating shaft may not assemble. The designer should add a note specifying that the H7 dimension applies after anodizing, or provide a pre-coating size that allows for the coating buildup.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'DIMENSION D12 APPLIES AFTER HARD ANODIZING' or specify the pre-anodize bore size to leave room for the coating thickness."}]}
